tmd.nodeIds: string[133], same core node IDs as frozen structural-graph
tmd.nodeU: number[1201][133][3], displacement increment from gravity equilibrium
tmd.massRayleighForce_N: number[1201], mass-proportional Rayleigh term included in the actual mass equation balance
tmd.massForceResidual_N: number[1201], actual discrete solver equation residual before output rounding
tmd.forceOnSupport_N: number[1201], sum of spring and dashpot forces
tmd.windFactor: number[1201], same prescribed gust used for frozen dynamic response

windLoads.nodeIds: string[132], IDs of nodes with actually applied wind forces
windLoads.nodeXYZ_m: number[132][3], undeformed core application coordinates, Y-up metres
windLoads.baseForce_N: number[132][3]; physical time force = baseForce_N * windFactor
windLoads.display: Arrow tip follows its actual displaced core node. These are net nodal forces, not facade pressures.

coreWindSection.memberIds: string[132], same equivalent core beam IDs as frozen graph
coreWindSection.sections: object[132], actual equivalent A, Iy, Iz, cy, cz used for stress conversion
coreWindSection.momentY_Nm: number[61][132][2], wind-only local end bending moments with aligned internal sign
coreWindSection.momentZ_Nm: number[61][132][2], wind-only local end bending moments with aligned internal sign
coreWindSection.extremeMPa: number[61][132], unsigned nominal section normal-stress envelope from axial plus biaxial bending
coreWindSection.display: Separate fixed unsigned 0..6 MPa legend; not tensile/compressive axial stress, wall-local von Mises stress, or facade pressure.

tmd.validation: Actual equation-of-motion balance and comparison to frozen response.dynamic

pile.coordinates: local X horizontal, Y upward; head localY0. Place head at existing model pile-head anchor; depths increase downward.
pile.datumNote: 33m aligns the existing reconstruction. Zhu design mat top25.4m + thickness6m implies31.4m; excavation depth33m does not establish an as-built raft bottom. Springs were recomputed at33m against original absolute soil layer boundaries.
pile.loadFactor: number[41], 0..1; progress of static loading, NOT consolidation time
pile.stages: 41 computed load increments; linear interpolation between adjacent increments allowed

stageFields.sideReactionOnPile_N: number[n][2], X/Y reaction on pile; soil receives opposite force
stageFields.toeReactionOnPile_N: number[2], X/Y, toe upward component in index1
stageFields.sideShearStress_Pa: number[n], interface vertical reaction divided by tributary circumference area, NOT soil von Mises stress
stageFields.axialForce_N: number[n-1], beam member axial force, tension positive

flow.description: No building CFD pressure/velocity field obtained. Current lines may only be labelled flow-mechanism illustration. Actual tower wind dynamics uses Zwind/OpenSees prescribed forces.
flow.iwind: Local directory is film/preview adapter, not a runnable building CFD backend
flow.diffusion: Available OC4 surrogate is fixed floating 5MW wind-turbine domain; inapplicable to this building

memberStressStats: Fixed full-time percentiles and maxima by member role; use fixed labelled scale for each shot, not per-frame renormalization
